about: Tests that checks.st3 does not run because the Nix build sandbox cannot provide what they need. They still run in central CI (nextest, linux-tests shards) and on the wrapper path, so nothing is dropped, only moved. The check fails if an entry here no longer names exactly one test, or if any unlisted test fails. Every entry needs a reason and an owner.

exclusions.reason: The daemon captures the account's login-shell environment and the Nix build user has no login shell ('the user account has no default shell'). Not a missing input; the sandbox cannot provide one.
exclusions.runs_instead: central CI linux-tests shards and the wrapper path
